description: This PHP class defines a 'Column' used within a reporting header for the OrangeHRM system, encapsulating properties such as name, property identifier, pinning options, size, and cell properties.

classes.name: Column
classes.description: Represents a column in a report header, with attributes like name, property, pinning position, size, and cell properties, along with methods to modify and retrieve these attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the column with a property identifier.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the column.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets the name of the column.

methods.name: getProp
methods.description: Returns the property identifier of the column.

methods.name: setProp
methods.description: Sets the property identifier of the column.

methods.name: getPin
methods.description: Returns the pinning status of the column (null, start, or end).

methods.name: setPin
methods.description: Sets the pinning position of the column, validating allowed values.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the column.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Sets the size of the column.

methods.name: addCellProperties
methods.description: Merges additional cell properties into the existing set.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Returns an associative array representation of the column properties.
